name: The Man Born Blind
title: Witness to Christ's Divine Power
summary: The man born blind was a beggar in Jerusalem whom Jesus healed on the Sabbath by applying clay to his eyes. His courageous testimony before the Pharisees and his confession of faith in Jesus as the Son of God make him a powerful example of spiritual awakening.

keyEvents.title: Born Blind from Birth
keyEvents.description: The man had been blind all his life, and the disciples asked Jesus whether it was his sin or that of his parents that caused the blindness.

keyEvents.title: Jesus Heals Him
keyEvents.description: Jesus spat on the ground, made clay, applied it to the man's eyes, and told him to wash in the Pool of Siloam. When he did so, he received his sight.

keyEvents.title: Testifying to Neighbors
keyEvents.description: After the healing, neighbors barely recognized him, and he had to explain what had happened to him.

keyEvents.title: Interrogated by the Pharisees
keyEvents.description: The Pharisees questioned him repeatedly about the healing that took place on the Sabbath, and he boldly testified that Jesus must be from God.

keyEvents.title: Cast Out of the Synagogue
keyEvents.description: Because of his testimony about Jesus, he was cast out of the synagogue by the Jewish leaders.

keyEvents.title: Confessing faith in Jesus
keyEvents.description: Jesus sought him out after he had been cast out, revealed himself as the Son of Man, and the man confessed his faith and worshiped him.
